# ubuntu_system_info Data Source

Reads system_info data via the hostsession.

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "ubuntu_system_info" "example" {
  target = var.host
}
```
## Argument Reference

The data source accepts the following arguments:

- `port` (Optional, Computed, int64) - Target port for this data source. Overrides provider default_target.port.
- `target` (Optional, Computed, string) - Target host or address for this data source. Overrides provider default_target.target.
- `transport` (Optional, Computed, string) - Transport for this data source. The current provider surface supports ssh.

## Attribute Reference

In addition to the configured arguments, this data source exports the following attributes:

- `apparmor` (bool) - Whether AppArmor is present.
- `arch` (string) - CPU architecture (e.g. x86_64, aarch64).
- `distro` (string) - Distribution name.
- `distro_family` (string) - Distribution family (e.g. debian, rhel).
- `hostname` (string) - System hostname.
- `id` (string) - Unique identifier for this data source.
- `init_system` (string) - Init system (e.g. systemd).
- `kernel` (string) - Kernel name (e.g. Linux).
- `kernel_version` (string) - Kernel version string.
- `package_manager` (string) - Default package manager (e.g. apt, dnf).
- `selinux` (bool) - Whether SELinux is present.
